fallback_responses.unclear_input: I'm not sure I understand. Could you please clarify what you're looking for? I'm here to help! 😊
fallback_responses.no_products_found: I couldn't find products matching your exact criteria. Let me show you some popular options instead! 🎯
fallback_responses.error_occurred: I encountered an issue processing your request. Please try again or contact support if the problem persists. 🔧
fallback_responses.maintenance_mode: I'm currently undergoing maintenance. Please try again in a few minutes. Thank you for your patience! ⚙️
fallback_responses.invalid_input: I didn't quite catch that. Could you please rephrase your question? I'm here to help! 🤔
fallback_responses.off_topic: That's an interesting question! However, I'm specialized in helping with digital products. How can I assist you with finding the perfect product? 🛍️
